summary: A beat-making firmware for dusty breaks and drum loops, with generated rhythms, an 8-lane step editor and recordable punch-in effects.
features: 76 factory sounds incl. 12 breaks, plus three 80 KiB expansion banks
Six styles and sixteen rhythm families with swing, variation and lane locks
8 lanes of 32 steps; A/B parts, intro, drop, outro and fills
Roll, stutter, reverse, brake and more, recorded to a 1 to 8 bar FX tape
USB MIDI clock out; MIDI in over USB or jack; no MIDI note output
Browser editor with WAV import and bounce; can't upload projects to the device
